content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Gumroad offers a simple way to sell digital products, but it comes with serious limitations, including high fees and a lack of control over the sales process. Stripe, on the other hand, provides a robust payment processing system, but its availability is limited to 46 countries, leaving out a significant portion of the global digital market. PayPal, a widely accepted payment method, can be restrictive and has been known to freeze funds for extended periods without appeal. NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment processor, offers instant verification and no fees for the creator, but it requires a deep understanding of blockchain technology. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack provides a comprehensive solution that includes a payment processor, order storage, file delivery, and automated payment verification, all without relying on Stripe or PayPal, empowering creators to build a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure that puts them in control of their sales process and financial transactions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad, Stripe, and PayPal are all limited in their ability to serve creators in restricted countries, either due to local regulations or their own technical restrictions. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a more accessible solution, supporting over 300 cryptocurrencies and allowing creators to accept payments directly on their website. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack takes this concept to the next level by providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that is not only available globally but also empowers creators to build their own payment processing systems, free from the limitations and restrictions imposed by third-party platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, Stripe and PayPal are often the more expensive options, with fees ranging from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction to as high as 12.99% for PayPal's Standard Plan. NOWPayments, on the other hand, charges no fees to the creator, but requires a deep understanding of blockchain technology to set up and manage. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack offers a more transparent and cost-effective solution, with a flat fee of $197 for the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes deployment of the Edge Commerce Stack in 48 hours, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments, 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff, providing creators with a comprehensive solution that minimizes real costs and maximizes payment speed.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Gumroad, Stripe, and PayPal all require creators to cede control over their sales process and financial transactions, making it difficult for them to maintain ownership and automate delivery. NOWPayments offers a more decentralized solution, but it still requires creators to manage their own cryptocurrency payments and delivery systems. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack takes this concept to the next level by providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that empowers creators to build and manage their own payment processing systems, automate delivery, and maintain complete ownership and control over their digital products, without relying on third-party platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When choosing an architecture for selling digital products, creators should consider their level of technical expertise, the complexity of their sales process, and their need for control and automation. For creators who require a simple and easy-to-use solution, Gumroad may be a viable option. For those who need more advanced features and control, NOWPayments or COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack may be a better choice. For creators who require a comprehensive solution that includes payment processing, order storage, file delivery, and automated payment verification, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack is the clear winner, providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that empowers creators to build and manage their own payment processing systems, automate delivery, and maintain complete ownership and control over their digital products.
